items.blurb: Supported production of the poloidal field magnets for the SPARC tokamak. I designed, prototyped, and implemented custom tooling, fixtures, and mechanical equipment to improve manufacturing processes. My work combined CAD design, first-principles engineering calculations, hands-on testing, and collaboration with technicians to develop practical solutions for the factory floor.

As an Operations Engineering Co-op at Raytheon, I supported the production of circuit cards for missile and radar systems. My work spanned manufacturing process development, tooling design, and production improvement. I developed thermal profiles and custom tools to improve solder rework, conducted stencil studies to control solder volume, and streamlined operator interfaces for rework equipment.

I've been involved with Northeastern's Aerospace Club (AeroNU) as a member, Liquid Rocketry Lead, and Vice President. Through these roles, I've helped design, build, and test liquid rocket propulsion systems while developing experience in both engineering and team leadership.

As part of the Liquid Rocketry team, I've worked on injector design, fluid and pressurization systems, instrumentation, and test hardware.

aboutSection.heading: Hi, I'm Ryan.
aboutSection.lede: I'm a mechanical engineer, focused on clean energy and aerospace.
aboutSection.bio: I'm currently designing a low-cost mechanical release system for underwater robotic recovery as part of my senior capstone. I'm also working on the feed system for Northeastern's liquid rocket engine project. Previously, I worked in manufacturing engineering at Commonwealth Fusion Systems, supporting the poloidal field magnets for the SPARC tokamak, and at Raytheon, where I gained experience in process improvement and production engineering.

items.title: Running
items.body: I love running! I'm President of Northeastern's Running Club. I've recently broken into longer distances. I've run a trail 50k and placed 800th overall at the Boston Marathon in 2026.

items.title: Music
items.body: I have a great appreciation for music. I played trumpet in high school, picked up guitar my junior year, and now play rhythm guitar in an alt-rock band.

items.title: Interior Design & Plants
items.body: I have always had an appreciation for small details, and I bring that into the spaces I live in. I also love flowers and plants!

contactSection.heading: We should talk!
contactSection.body: I'm always up for chatting about clean energy, aerospace, manufacturing, or design. Drop me a line!
